title: fix(next-app-router): using wrong initial results when mounting on client
body:
**Summary**

Fixes #6086

**Result**

Starting from Next 14, pressing the back button to go back to a different page does not cause a server-side render, so `InstantSearchNext` would read the `initialResults` again even if the route has changed.
The easiest way to fix this is to delete them from window when disposing (not after reading as this may cause issues in strict mode)

@sarahdayan 
We didn't setup unit tests yet due to the experimental nature of the package which is still prone to change. Also we have to test server-side rendering *and* hydration altogether.

So ideally we should have e2e tests with a matrix of Next.js versions (behavior was different between 13.5, 14.0 and 14.1) but I think saucelabs tests are too flaky and we should change CI to only run tests if the actual code has changed.
We should add proper e2e tests before we release 1.0, but we'll have to solve the above points (This is in the backlog of points to address for it to go GA)
